title: Publish-triggered alerts per list rule, deduplicated per item per list
description: Hook on the publish path (newsroom and CLI) when PublishResult.changed: async invoke newsletter item-published. Rules by section, tag or type; dedupe per lineage per list; approval gate per list, instant sends only when the site enables them. Never fails a publish.

comments.text: Merged to develop: PR 543 (5e28cbf). Hook: papyrus_content/publish_alerts.py announce_published, called from content-actions project_item_action (newsroom) and run_projection_task (CLI, marked task); item-published handled by newsletter/alerts.py. Tests: pytest, behave newsletter-alerts.feature, plugin synth. Not promoted to main. Story left open for the panel and live verification.
